anuseti.p: [Anu+si+a+ti] (kri) CL=8 A) of numbers. Repeatedly happening. Happening in order. Having appropriate reason - being coincident - B) due to, according to - because of - make it happen, make it happen again and again
a: အနုသေတိ(ကြိ)

C: anuseti：[anu-seti，Sk. anuśayate] 隨眠，隨増，潛在. pp. anusayita.
B:
anuseti：anuseti（kri）
အနုသေတိ（ကြိ）
[anu+si+a+ti]
[အနု+သိ+အ+တိ]
P: Anuseti，[anu + seti. cp. Sk. anuśayate or° śete，from śī] to “lie down with”，i. e. （1） trs. to dwell on，harp on （an idea） S.II，65； III，36； IV，208. -- 2. （of the idea） to obsess，to fill the mind persistently，to lie dormant & be continually cropping up. M.I，40，108，433； S.II，54 （so read with SS for anusavanti） IV.188； A.I，283； III，246； Pug.32，48. -- pp. anusayita （q. v.）. （Page 44）
K:
anuseti：＂အနုသေတိ（ကြိ）
[အနု+သိ+အ+တိ]
（က） ကိန်း၏၊ အဖန်ဖန် ဖြစ်၏၊ အစဉ်လိုက်၍ ဖြစ်၏၊ လျော်သော အကြောင်းရသော်-အကြောင်းတိုက်ဆိုင်သော်-ဖြစ်၏။ （ခ） စွဲ၍-အကြောင်းပြု၍-ဖြစ်၏။ （ဂ） ဖြစ်စေ၏၊ အဖန်ဖန်ဖြစ်စေ၏။
R:
anuseti：အနု-သေတိ （အနု√သီ）
ကိန်း၏။ လျောင်း၏။
DOP: anuseti pr. 3 sg. [anu 1 + seti 1 ; S. anuśete], 1. clings to, is occupied with ; S II 65, 16 (yaṃ ca … ceteti yaṃ ca pakappeti yaṃ ca ~eti ārammaṇaṃ etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā); III 35, 9 (yaṃ kho bhikkhu ~eti tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati); — 2. lies latent; inheres; recurs persistently ; D II 64, 17 (~etī ti); M I 433, 1 (~eti tv ev’ assa sakkāyadiṭṭhānusayo); A I 283, 18 (kodho dīgharattaṃ ~eti); Sv 1040, 24 (appahīnaṭṭhena ~entī ti anusayā); Paṭis I 123, 35 (yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ ettha sattānaṃ kāmarāgānusayo ~eti); Yam 268, 9 foll. (kattha kāmarāgānusayo ~eti); — pp anusayita , mfn. , inherent, peristent, latent ; Sn 649 (dīgharattaṃ ~aṃ diṭṭhigataṃ ajānataṃ); Vism 688, 17 (~-ttā); Pj II 350, 29 (taṇhā dīgharattaṃ appahīnaṭṭhena ~ā); — ifc see dīgharattâ-.
CPD: anu-seti , pr. 3 sg. [ sa. anu + √śī], (a) said of a person: to adhere, to cling to, to be occupied about, ( acc ); yañ ca ~, SN ll 65, 16 foll.; yaṃ . . . ~eti tena saṃkhaṃ gacchati, SN lll 35, 10 foll.; — (b) said of things: to lie dormant ( continually arising again ); rāgânusayo, etc. , ~ ( paron. ), MN l 303, 33 foll.; lll 285, 8 foll.; sakkāyadiṭṭhânusayo, etc. , ~, MN l 433, 1 foll.; kāmacchando . . . nâ°, SN anu-seti = Pp 32, 23 = 48, 15 ; kāmataṇhā, etc. , ~, AN ll 10, 24 foll. (= nibbattati, Mp); kāmanandi, etc. , nâ°, AN lll 246, 18 foll.; kāmarāgânusayo, etc. , ~, Yam l 268, 9 foll.; Paṭis l 123, 35 foll.; rūpiṃ parittattânu- diṭṭhi ~, DN ll 64, 17 (Sv (ll) 505, 8 -n); vedanāya avijjā ~, Nett 32, 12 (Nett-a quotes MN l 303, 10 -n); As 254, 22 (thāmagataṭṭhena anuset[ī/i]ti anusayo); 3 pl. ~enti (saññā), MN l 108, 32 (nâ°); MN l 40, 23 (diṭṭhiyo); [~ayanti (āsavā), SN ll 54, 3 ( v. l. for anu-(s)savanti); SN lV 188, 10 —189, 9 ( do. )]; Sv (lll) 1040, 24 (appahīnaṭṭhena anusent[ī/i]ti anusayā); Ja lV 13, 4 ' (= 'senti'); — pp. anu-sayita, q. v.
NCP: pr. 3 sg. clings to, is occupied with. lies latent; inheres; recurs persistently.
